notes: Page 2 shows only parts-sorting advice (sort by colour). No building step, so no pieces or joins were added.

Page 3 shows only minifigure assembly (helmet, head, torso, legs) for the firefighter, plus the finished woman minifigure and the white kitten. Minifigure parts are not in the official parts list, so no pieces were recorded. The kitten (lego-6251) is shown but not placed on anything yet.
Step 1: the pillar (b2) goes on the centre stud of the jumper plate (b1), which is the base. rests_on: b2 on b1.
Step 2: the leaves (b3) go on top of the pillar. rests_on: b3 on b2.
Step 3: the kitten (b4) is placed on the leaves, so it rests on b3. It has no studs, so it is recorded as contact only. The two minifigures are not in the parts list and are not recorded.
The silver fish (lego-64648) is shown in the parts box but is not placed on this page, so it is not recorded yet.
The pillar and the plant have no catalogue port for the bottom socket. So u_port is null on those joins.
Page 5, step 1 of the fire chief car: the vehicle base (b5) is the first piece of this model. It clutches nothing below, so it has no rests_on.
Page 6, step 2: two wheel-holder plates (b6, b7) are pushed onto the underside of the two ends of the vehicle base (b5), one at the front and one at the rear. Each rests on b5 from below.
The exact stud and anti-stud pairs are not recorded because the page does not show them. So port names are left null on these joins.
Page 7, step 3: the model is turned over. A white 2 x 4 plate (b8) is pressed into the 4 x 2 recess in the centre of the vehicle base (b5). rests_on: b5.
Port names on b5 are left null because the page does not show the exact studs.
Page 8, step 4 builds a small front-end sub-assembly. It is not yet joined to the car.
Step 1: the special 2 x 4 brick (b9) is the first piece of the sub-assembly, so nothing is beneath it.
Step 2: two red 1 x 1 plates (b10, b11) go on the two end studs of b9. rests_on: b9.
Step 3: a dark gray 1 x 4 plate (b12) is attached to the side of b9 with its studs facing outward. It is a side attachment, not resting on top.
The parts box also shows a red 1 x 4 brick, a white 1 x 2 tile, two trans-red round tiles and two dark gray slopes. They are not placed on this page, so they are not recorded yet.
Port names on b9 and b12 are left null because the page does not show the exact studs.
Page 9, steps 4-6 finish the rear-light sub-assembly started on page 8. It is not yet joined to the car.
Step 4: a dark gray 1 x 2 slope (b13) is pressed onto two studs of the 1 x 4 plate b12. Only one slope is shown here, so the second slope from the parts box is still unplaced.
Step 5: the red 1 x 4 brick (b14) is shown with its studs facing out. It rests on b12, and the exact stud contact is uncertain. The white 1 x 2 tile (b15) goes on two studs of b14.
Step 6: the two trans-red round tiles (b16, b17) go on the red 1 x 1 plates b10 and b11.
The exact stud pairings in this side-on view are my best reading. Port names on b14 and b12 are partly left null.
Page 10 adds no new pieces. The rear-light sub-assembly from pages 8-9 is pushed onto the rear end studs of the vehicle base (b5). Its main piece b9 sits on b5.
Port names are left null because the page does not show the exact studs.

Page 11, step 5: two rear wheel arches (b18, b19), one on each side of the rear end. One is shown already in place and one is being added. Each is recorded as resting on the vehicle base (b5) and the rear sub-assembly piece b9.
The page does not show which studs each arch lands on. So port names are left null, and the stud contacts are my best reading.

Page 12, step 6: a light gray 1 x 2 brick (b20) goes on the studs of the far-side rear wheel arch (b19). A yellow 2 x 2 plate (b21) goes across the white 2 x 4 plate (b8) and the neighbouring studs of the vehicle base (b5).
The page does not show which arch or which studs these land on. So the b19 choice and the null port names are my best reading.
Page 13, step 7: the yellow steering stand (b22) goes on two studs of the yellow 2 x 2 plate (b21). rests_on: b21.
The page does not show which two studs of b21 it covers. The stud names are my best reading.
Page 14, step 8: a dark gray 1 x 2 slope (b24) is pressed onto a light gray 1 x 2 brick (b23) to make the dashboard. Both are placed on this page.
The dashboard is then added to the car, in front of the steering stand, on the two free studs of the yellow plate (b21). The page does not show the exact studs, so the stud names are my best reading.
Page 15, step 9 is built 2x. These are the two roof side rails. Both copies are listed: b25-b27 and b28-b30. They are not yet joined to the car.
Each copy: a white 1 x 4 plate (b26, b29) goes into the recess of a red inverted slope (b25, b28). A red 1 x 4 panel (b27, b30) then goes on the plate's studs.
Step 3 adds a 'FIRE 60001' sticker to each panel, taken from the sticker sheet lego-11843. Stickers are not recorded as pieces.
The catalogue entry for lego-52501 lists only anti-stud ports, so the slope's side of each join is left null.
Page 16 adds no new pieces. The two side rail assemblies from page 15 (b25-b27 and b28-b30) are pushed onto the studs along the two long sides of the vehicle base (b5). rests_on: b5.
Only one side is clearly visible, and the other side is hidden. Port names are left null because the exact studs are not shown.
Page 17, step 10: a white 2 x 4 plate (b31) goes on the rear deck, over the light gray brick b20, the wheel arch plate b19 and the rear piece b9.

Page 18, step 12: three red 1 x 4 plates (b34, b35, b36) are added around the edges of the white rear deck. One runs along each long side and one along the end.
The page does not show exactly which white plates each red plate covers. The contacts and the null port names are my best reading.

Step 14: two more wheel arches (b41, b42) go on the front end of the vehicle base (b5), one on each side. rests_on: b5.
The page does not show which white plates each panel or the tile covers, so the contacts and the null port names are my best reading.
Page 20, step 15 builds the front grille sub-assembly. It is not yet joined to the car.

Step 2: two trans-yellow cheese slopes (b45, b46) are added at the two ends of the grille, as headlights.

Page 21, left: no new piece. The front grille sub-assembly from page 20 is pushed onto the front end of the vehicle base (b5). Its main piece b43 sits on b5, between the front wheel arches b41 and b42.
Step 16: the fourth red 1 x 4 plate (b48) goes across the front, on the studs of b43 and the two front wheel arches (b41, b42), in front of the dashboard.
The page does not show exact studs. So the contacts and the null port names are my best reading.

Page 22, step 17: two dark gray hinge plates (b49, b50) go on the front studs of the car, in front of the red plate b48, with the hinge finger facing the front. Only one is shown arriving, and the second is assumed to be a mirrored copy on the other side. rests_on: b43.
The parts box also shows the red curved wedge brick (lego-11291), the hood. It is not placed on this page, so it is not recorded yet.

Page 23, step 18: two red curved 3 x 1 bricks (b51, b52) make the hood. They go on the front studs, over the hinge plates (b49, b50) and the front piece b43.

Step 19: two trans-light blue windscreens (b53, b54), one on each side of the cabin. Each rests on the studs of a side rail slope and a neighbouring piece. The page does not show exactly which, so those contacts are my best reading.

Page 24, step 20: a yellow round 1 x 1 brick (b55) goes on the rear deck beside the blue seats, and the yellow tap (b56) goes on top of it. A black radio (b57) is placed on the deck next to it.

Page 25, step 21: the red curved roof (b58) goes on top of the two windscreens (b53, b54). rests_on: b53, b54.

Added the third dark gray 1 x 2 slope (lego-85984). The page 8 box shows 2 slopes for the rear-light sub-assembly. Page 9 showed only one (b13), so b70 is the second, on the other two studs of the 1 x 4 plate b12.

Added the red curved wedge hood (lego-11843 was the sticker sheet; the hood is lego-11291, b71). It was in the page 22 parts box but I had not placed it. I put it on the two hinge plates (b49, b50) and the front piece b43. These contacts are my best reading, not shown in a step.
Added the sticker sheet (b72) as one part. Its stickers go on the two side panels (b27, b30) and the roof (b58), recorded as contact edges.
Added the silver fish (lego-64648, b69). It appears only in the page 4 tree parts box, and no step shows where it goes. I recorded it as resting on the tree base plate b1, which is an assumption.
The earlier parts-list mismatch also listed the tap, plates and the rest as fine. Only these four were missing.

This is not a real problem, so I added nothing. Set 60001 builds two separate models. Page 4 builds a tree on its own base plate (b1-b4, plus the fish b69), and pages 5-27 build the fire chief car (b5 onward). No step joins the tree to the car; the booklet shows them side by side only in the finished pictures.
Joining them would invent a connection the booklet never makes. So both groups stay separate.
